# Lesson Plan Website - File Structure Summary

## Generated Files (14 total)

### HTML Pages (11 files)
1. **index.html** (70 lines) - Main homepage with navigation grid and progress tracking
2. **learning-outcomes.html** (62 lines) - 4 ILOs with Bloom's Taxonomy levels
3. **pre-class.html** (79 lines) - Pre-reading video, 5-question pre-test, reflection
4. **introduction.html** (69 lines) - 8-min hook activity, pre-test review, real-world connection
5. **development.html** (96 lines) - 42-min scaffolded activities (I do → We do → You do)
6. **synthesis.html** (58 lines) - 10-min closure with post-test and peer teaching
7. **assessment.html** (109 lines) - Formative/summative assessments, interactive quizzes, rubrics
8. **alignment.html** (69 lines) - Constructive alignment matrix with visual representation
9. **resources.html** (103 lines) - LMS, physical materials, digital tools with setup instructions
10. **differentiation.html** (89 lines) - Support strategies for all learner types
11. **reflection.html** (71 lines) - Teacher reflection prompts and modification strategies
12. **slides.html** (92 lines) - 10-slide classroom presentation with navigation

### Supporting Files (3 files)
13. **styles.css** (248 lines) - Complete responsive styling with card-based design
14. **app.js** (155 lines) - Interactive features, progress tracking, quiz logic

### Documentation
15. **README.md** - Complete usage guide

## Key Features Implemented

### ✅ Interactive Features
- Pre-test with 5 questions and instant feedback
- Independent practice worksheets with answer checking
- Post-test comparison with pre-test
- Exit ticket submission
- Summative quiz with scoring (5 questions)
- Real-time Mentimeter poll integration
- Slideshow with prev/next navigation (10 slides)

### ✅ Progress Tracking
- localStorage-based progress saving
- Visual progress bar on homepage
- Section completion markers
- Quiz results preservation
- Reflection saving

### ✅ Role Differentiation
- Teacher/Student role selector
- Teacher-only notes and tips
- Different content visibility based on role

### ✅ External Tool Integration
Step-by-step instructions for:
- **Mentimeter** (real-time polling)
- **Khan Academy** (pre-class video)
- **Kahoot** (gamified practice)
- **Padlet** (collaborative reflection)
- **Google Classroom** (LMS)

### ✅ Pedagogical Elements
- Scaffolded Instruction (I do → We do → You do)
- Bloom's Taxonomy alignment
- Constructive Alignment matrix
- Differentiation for 5 learner types:
  - Struggling learners
  - Advanced learners
  - English Language Learners
  - Kinesthetic learners
  - Accessibility accommodations

### ✅ Responsive Design
- Mobile-friendly layout
- Card-based interface
- Flexbox/Grid layouts
- Touch-friendly buttons

## Content Coverage

All sections from the original lesson plan are included:
1. ✅ Intended Learning Outcomes (4 ILOs)
2. ✅ Pre-Class Preparation (video, pre-test, reflection)
3. ✅ Teaching & Learning Activities (introduction, development, synthesis)
4. ✅ Assessment Methods (formative + summative)
5. ✅ Constructive Alignment Matrix
6. ✅ Required Resources & Technology
7. ✅ Differentiation & Inclusivity
8. ✅ Reflection & Improvement
9. ✅ Presentation Slides (10 slides)

## Usage Instructions

1. Open `index.html` in any modern web browser
2. Select Teacher or Student role
3. Navigate through sections in sequence
4. Complete interactive activities
5. All progress is saved automatically

## No Dependencies Required
- Pure HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6)
- No frameworks or libraries
- No server needed
- Works offline after initial load
- Cross-browser compatible

- HTML: ~807 lines across 11 files
